name: GenesisVR
summary:
Step beyond time and space into GenesisVR, an awe-inspiring virtual reality journey through the Six Days of Creation — from the first spark of divine intention to the birth of light, life, and consciousness itself.

Before the world was formed, before words were spoken, there was only infinite potential — the Kabbalistic sequence that preceded creation. In GenesisVR, you will experience these hidden moments through stunning visuals, immersive soundscapes, and sacred symbolism inspired by ancient teachings.
